title: Define the diagnostic backfill contract before enabling its selector
blocker: Migration `drizzle/0020_dizzy_dazzler.sql` makes `spf_auth_result` NOT NULL with the legitimate default `none`, so `backfillDiagnosticFields` currently selects no rows. Replacing the predicate alone risks attaching another XML record's fields to an event: `groupEventIdsByReport` preserves an unordered query's order, while `backfillReportEvents` pairs event IDs and parsed records by index. **Blocked on:** choosing an explicit whole-report reparse contract with stable identity/order and count validation, or a reliable legacy ownership marker. Verify that contract with reordered and subset fixtures before enabling writes. No database operation was run during the 2026-10-22 audit.
